occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection expired on July 14, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A caregiver was observed to be supervising children without an active, eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed supervising 6 children with a specified age group of 12m to 17m.    Note: Another caregiver stepped in the classroom and the room was within ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Two diaper changing mats were observed to be torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One out of seven records evaluated did not have the following trainings: hazardous materials and administering medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Six month old infant was observed sleeping in a bouncer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed supervising 8 children ranging from ages 7 months to 18 months.     Note: It was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area: The infant classroom and the toddler room have diaper changing tables.  The classrooms do not have hand-washing sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area (26 TAC §746.4403(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Six employee files were reviewed. Two employees were missing training in allergic reactions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Diaper changing mat was had two holes of approximataly 1 inch in diameter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: Diaper changing supplies were within children's reach in two classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Six children's files were reviewed.  Five files did not include health statement signed by health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Activity plans in four classrooms only included one opportunity for outdoor play.   Activitiy plans in three classrooms did not include the dates and group names.  Activity plan was not available for the school age classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Plan for Extreme Weather: Operational policies were pending information on a plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather   conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play, local abuse and neglect organizations, hearing and vision requirements, updated immunization records, and field trips.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Required monthly test for carbon monoxide detector, and monthly inpection of fire extinguishers have not been conducted since January 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: List of the children being transported and emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child  being transported were not included in information carried in transportation vehicle.      First aid kit was missing a thermometer.     Note: Information was included in transportation binder during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Six children's files were evaluated. One file was missing the required admission information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Infant group of children was  observed watching television.     Note: it was corrected during inspection, by turning off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Child care operation sign in/sign out log was not maintainted,  The last day it was completed was on 11/28/2022, and the sign out time was not documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The operation has a step-2 Clubhouse Climber in the outside playground. The designated play surface has a height of 23 inches.  The operation has turf grass, under the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Employee observed supervising children did not have an active, eligible background check on file.      Note: employee left the center during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Small school bus used for transportation is not equipped with the required electronic child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Garbage cans in classrooms were uncovered. They did not have a lid.  Garbage was accessible to children.     Cleaning supplies were inside a closet.  It was unlocked. Closet is in school age classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Health environmental inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Activity plans posted in one toddler classroom, and one pre-k classroom were for previous weeks.    Activity plan in school age classroom was  not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: Carbon monoxide monthly test documentation was not available for review.      Fire extinguishers' monthly inspections documentations was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))
